title: The Role of Visual Attention in the Managerial Judgment of Balanced-Scorecard Performance Evaluation: Insights from using an Eye-Tracking Device

scopes.description: The author-described statistical workflow from the supplied participant-level analysis workbook through the SPSS analyses for H1–H3 and the separate median-split robustness result in Online Appendix Table A1. The package includes a manual SPSS route and prepared analysis data, but no executable analysis program.

requirements.description: The authors’ prepared participant-level statistical-analysis dataset is required for the documented H1–H3 procedures and the separate Appendix Table A1 median-split analysis. The data-description sheet states that the combined Excel dataset is the input for statistical analysis. The packaged workbook is readable, has 60 nonempty participant rows (matching the 60 Appendix A1 observations), includes the documented analysis fields, and has a variable-description sheet. The bounded inspection verifies the supplied file and fields, not every cell-level result or the authors’ full calculation history.

routes.description: The supplied author workbook is explicitly identified as the dataset used for statistical analyses. The existing bounded metadata probe confirms a readable first-sheet data table with required raw headers; a separate bounded read-only inspection finds 60 participant rows and variable definitions. The supplied prepared data support the documented statistical route, so the historical eye-tracking video/tagging stages are not separate live raw-input requirements for this scope.

software.name: SPSS 22
software.description: The data-description sheet specifies SPSS version 22 for the statistical analyses. Local licensed availability, exact version, and the prescribed Excel-import behavior have not been verified.

issues.description: The package supplies an actual manual SPSS procedure: H1 uses a mean split and chi-square crosstab, while H2/H3 use a two-level repeated-measures ANOVA. The appendix separately identifies Table A1 as a median-split result. No executable SPSS syntax is supplied, and exact menu settings/output mapping and the import mapping from workbook header PresentationFormat to the data-sheet factor Presentation are not fully documented. The manual route is present; full procedural closure and a runnable program are not.

evidence.description: The author sheet provides manual H1 instructions for constructing Match, mean-splitting the linked-duration ratio, and using SPSS crosstabs/chi-square.
evidence.quote: We split the linked duration ratio using SPSS Visual Binning based on the mean to get above the above mean and below mean groups.

evidence.description: The author sheet gives the repeated-measures factor, two levels, between-subject factor, and covariates for H2/H3.
evidence.quote: We define Favored Measures as the Within Subject Factor in the SPSS Repeated Measures menu with two levels which are Linked fixation ratio and Non-linked fixation ratio.

evidence.description: Online Appendix Table A1 is expressly a separate median-split analysis.
evidence.quote: Online Appendix Table A1: Chi‐square contingency table Using Median‐Split

evidence.description: Appendix A1 reports 60 observations in its displayed contingency table, consistent with the packaged workbook row count.
The supplied bounded workbook metadata probe reports status ok, readable true, and the raw first-sheet headers used for the statistical input.

A bounded read-only workbook inspection confirms 60 nonempty participant rows in the analysis sheet and a variable-description sheet defining the participant, fixation-ratio, Match, presentation, experience, and gender fields.
The frozen static audit reports no supported executable code and no code entry points; the package contains the workbook and two documents.

actions.description: Obtain the exact author SPSS syntax or fully specified manual settings for the supplied analysis dataset.
steps: Ask the authors for executable SPSS syntax, if available, or the exact dialog options and output mapping for H1, H2/H3, and the supplementary Appendix A1 analysis.

Keep the data-description sheet’s main H1 mean-split procedure separate from Appendix Table A1’s explicitly reported median-split robustness analysis; request clarification only where exact output settings are not stated.

Confirm that the workbook raw header PresentationFormat maps to the documented Presentation factor and how the blank trailing AX header is handled on import. Do not infer a code repair from these header differences.

Use the supplied participant-level statistical dataset as the primary analysis input. Request historical Locarna videos/tagging intermediates only if the authors say the supplied workbook is insufficient for a documented statistical output.
validation: Confirm the author instructions map the supplied fields MATCH, LinkFixationRatio, NonLinkFixationRatio, PresentationFormat, Experience, and Gender to each described statistical procedure.
Confirm that the prepared workbook has the expected 60 participant records and that both mean-split H1 and median-split Appendix A1 remain distinct analyses.
After a separate authorized manual or scripted SPSS run, compare H1/H2/H3 and Appendix A1 outputs with the author reports; do not treat workbook readability alone as execution verification.

actions.description: Verify access to the author-specified SPSS version before attempting the manual analyses.
steps: Check whether licensed SPSS version 22 is available for the intended run. If it is not, request access or an author-confirmed compatible version before substituting another package.
validation: Record the SPSS version shown by the installed application and confirm it can import the workbook with the required fields before the later authorized analysis.

review_notes: The workbook is an author-prepared statistical-analysis dataset. Its stated historical Locarna video, tagging, CSV, and Excel PivotTable steps produced the supplied analysis input; they are not separate live requirements for the described statistical rerun unless author clarification shows otherwise.
The data-description sheet’s H1 mean split and Appendix Table A1 median split are preserved as distinct analyses, not treated as contradictory instructions.

The bounded metadata probe identifies the raw header PresentationFormat while the data-description sheet calls the between-subject factor Presentation; an extra trailing AX header is blank. No import repair is proposed without the author’s prescribed SPSS import behavior.
No analysis_only scope is added because the package supplies no executable code for such a scope; the documented manual statistical route is assessed under full_pipeline.
